description: Full accessibility lawsuit-risk scan of a website URL (ADA / WCAG triage). Fetches the page server-side and runs 20 weighted checks across image alt text and media captions, form labels and input purpose, page structure (lang, heading order, landmarks, skip link), links and interactive elements (link text, button names, target size, keyboard operability), color contrast (estimated from the page's own CSS) and document basics (title, viewport zoom, focus indicator, ARIA sanity). These are the failure classes plaintiff firms' scanners look for — they appear in ~96% of ADA website complaints. Returns machine-readable JSON: 0-100 score, A-F grade, a lawsuit-risk level (Low/Moderate/Elevated/High) with the failing plaintiff-scan checks named, per-check pass/partial/fail/unknown with evidence, and the top 3 prioritized fixes. HONEST LIMITS: this is an automated triage scan, not a WCAG/ADA compliance certification — automated tools catch roughly 30% of WCAG issues. Cost: $1.50 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402 — the caller's agent pays from its owner's approved wallet; no API key needed. Use this to triage a store's ADA lawsuit exposure before a demand letter arrives, or to scan a client portfolio for accessibility risk.

url.description: Website URL to scan, e.g. https://example-store.com
